## Step 4: Risk Assessment
### Customer Risk Level
Determine Risk Category:

description: Determining the risk level leads to the classification gate to categorize the customer.
context: Determine Risk Category:

description: Customer is classified as Low Risk if they meet criteria such as being a UK national with standard products and no PEP/adverse media.

properties.condition: UK national, Age 18-65, Standard product, UK address, No PEP/adverse media, Deposit <£100k

context:
Low Risk:
- UK national or long-term resident
- Age 18–65
- Standard product (SmartSaver, Current Account)
- UK address
- No PEP/adverse media
- Standard initial deposit (<£100k)

description: Customer is classified as Medium Risk if they meet criteria such as being a non-UK resident from an EU/developed country or having a higher-value account.

properties.condition: Non-UK resident (EU/developed), Age >65 or <25, Account >£50k, Foreign address (EU/developed), Professional/business account

context:
Medium Risk:
- Non-UK resident (but EU/developed country)
- Age >65 or <25
- Higher-value account (>£50k)
- Foreign address but EU/developed country
- Professional/business account

description: Customer is classified as High Risk if they are a PEP, have adverse media, or originate from a country with weak AML controls.

properties.condition: Non-UK national with foreign address, PEP, Adverse media, Unclear beneficial ownership, Account >£250k, Weak AML country

context:
High Risk:
- Non-UK national with foreign address
- PEP (Politically Exposed Person)
- Adverse media (criminal history, fraud)
- Beneficial ownership unclear
- High-value account (>£250k)
- Country with weak AML controls
